# We Book Leads

> We Book Leads puts an AI concierge on a service business's phone line and website. It answers customer questions, captures leads, and books appointments 24/7. The concierge always tells customers it is an AI.

## What it does

- Answers phone calls and website chat questions at any hour, trained on the business's own website content
- Books appointments directly into the business's calendar
- Follows up with new leads right away, day or night

## Who it is for

- Need-based service businesses anywhere in the United States: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, garage door, pest control, appliance repair, septic, locksmith, and similar trades

## Pricing

- Free 30-day trial, card on file at signup, nothing charged for 30 days
- $297 per month after the trial, no setup fee, cancel anytime
